column2: A masked hunter of the Ysanna, the native people of Ossus. Their spears fly truer than they should; the hunters do not know the Force guides them.
A warrior sworn to defend the tribe. The Ysanna descend from Jedi who outlived the Cron Supernova in the caves of the Eocho Mountains.
A tribal elder and healer. To the Ysanna the Force is magic, and the shamans are its keepers.
An acolyte of the One Sith, Darth Krayt's order, in hiding since his death. Acolytes still hunt the Jedi who survive on Ossus.
A trained warrior of the One Sith, marked with the red and black tattoos of Krayt's order.
